verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a public REST API with an OpenAPI 3.0 reference and a dated versioning policy, so developers can build against it. The evidence never mentions any official language SDKs or client libraries. Building would mean calling raw REST endpoints or generating a client yourself from the OpenAPI spec embedded in the docs page, which has no separate download URL. Missing for 10: official SDKs in any language, published client libraries or packages, SDK docs and examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.
